question: What is the standard Distribution Reward rate, and is there a boosted rate?
answer:
The standard Distribution Reward rate is **0.2%**. Per the [Distribution Reward Rate](/atlas/57384c49-e499-4c69-b22c-8e1f1dd34759), "The standard Distribution Reward rate is set at 0.2%," annualized on all USDS and sUSDS balances associated with the relevant Reward Code.

There is also a boosted rate: the [Boosted Distribution Reward Rate](/atlas/1d9219cb-9359-40de-96a0-ac60a8174c63) states "An additional 0.3% Boosted Distribution Reward rate will be available starting January 2026," and notes it "may be discontinued in the future at the discretion of Sky Governance." That brings the boosted total to 0.5% from January 2026.
